title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01936:20050430:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 1936, April 30, 2005>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) Of these Rules, provisions concerning the Jeonju Division of the Gwangju High Court shall enter into force on March 1, 2006, and provisions concerning the Cheongju Division of the Daejeon High Court shall enter into force on September 1, 2008.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Scope of Adjudicative Affairs) Cases to be tried by the Jeonju Division of the Gwangju High Court under amended Article 2 that are pending before the Gwangju High Court as of February 28, 2006, and cases to be tried by the Cheongju Division of the Daejeon High Court that are pending before the Daejeon High Court as of August 31, 2008, shall continue to be tried by the respective courts in which they are pending.
